Method of Attack: Exploitation of an insecure implementation of inter-process communications within ZoneAlarm's .NET WCF service running with SYSTEM privileges to execute arbitrary code and elevate local privileges
Use of self-signed certificate to bypass Check Point signature verification and gain SYSTEM privileges
Impacted Systems: Check Point ZoneAlarm free edition antivirus and firewall solution
Attack Vector: Local privilege escalation via named-pipe WCF service endpoints Cipolla and CipollaRoot
User interaction required to install self-signed certificate
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of WCF service endpoints Cipolla and CipollaRoot
Self-signed certificate with Common Name starting with 'Check Point Software Technologies'
